t_advice_summary_textbox.text: it is not so much the gnomes appearance but rather the colour of the gnome and figuring out which gnome goes to the two different forests

vb_textbox.text: there are four pair of gnomes that consistanaly appear, green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple and orange & brown; these four pairs alway go together.there a two forests a light and dark forest, the brown, pink, yellow and purple will lead you to a dark forest with a yellow basket and the green, red, blue and orange will lead you the light forest with a red basket
